sources.obp.note: MARC records for their books may be listed on this page. Availability can change.
sources.tip: Tip: the file must end in .mrc and be under 5 MB. A file with many records is fine, because after upload you choose up to 5 of them.
about.title: About NecroMARC
about.toc.label: On this page
about.what.title: What NecroMARC is and why it was built
about.what.p1: NecroMARC revives legacy library catalog records. It parses binary MARC files in the ISO 2709 format, scores how decayed each record is, rebuilds it into clean structured data, and shows the result in an archive and a knowledge graph.
about.what.p2: MARC 21 itself is an actively maintained standard, published and updated by the Library of Congress. The problem is the 1960s ISO 2709 binary flat-file container that holds so many historical records.
about.what.problems: That container leaves records in unindexed silos and causes these problems:
about.what.p.linked: No Linked Data support: no BIBFRAME and no JSON-LD.
about.audience.title: Who it is for
about.use.title: How to use it
about.use.s1: Browse the archive of resurrected records on the home page.
about.use.s2: Explore the knowledge graph to see how records connect.
about.use.s3: Try the Sample Tomb on the Summon page to resurrect a ready-made sample.
about.use.s4: Log in with Judge login. Uploading and resurrecting need a judge session.
about.use.s5: Upload a .mrc file of any size up to 5 MB.
about.use.s6: Choose up to 5 of the parsed records.
about.use.s7: Resurrect the selected records and open each one in its chamber.
about.use.limit: Why only 5 records? The limit protects the project's free AI quota.
about.use.sources: No .mrc file at hand? The Summon page lists sites with free MARC 21 records.
about.how.title: How it works and AI provenance
about.how.decay: Each record gets a decay score from fixed rules, such as missing fields or damaged encoding.
about.how.heal: An AI model heals the 520 summary, the 650 subjects and the 008 fixed field. It runs through OpenRouter.
about.how.embed: Gemini embeddings power semantic search. No machine-learning model runs locally.
about.how.prov: Every field the AI writes is marked with this subfield:
about.how.prov_note: Original fields never carry this mark.
about.how.export: Each record can be exported as ISO 2709, MARCXML or JSON-LD.
